tagline.en: IRIS — a transformer-based, sample-efficient world model that learns to imagine environment dynamics for reinforcement learning.
tagline.zh: IRIS——基于 Transformer 的样本高效世界模型,通过想象环境动态来支持强化学习。

en: IRIS, from Eloi Alonso and collaborators, is a world model for reinforcement learning. It learns the dynamics of an environment and then trains an agent largely inside that learned model — an approach known for being sample-efficient, letting an agent learn from relatively little real interaction.

The method pairs a discrete autoencoder, which turns observations into tokens, with an autoregressive transformer that predicts how those tokens evolve over time. The agent can then be rolled out in the model's imagined trajectories rather than only in the real environment.
In WorldFoundry, IRIS is tracked from its upstream source as a reference world-model project; the repository is the place to go for training and running it.
zh: IRIS 由 Eloi Alonso 等人提出,是一个面向强化学习的世界模型。它学习环境的动态,然后主要在这个学到的模型内部训练智能体——这类方法以样本高效著称,能让智能体从相对少量的真实交互中学习。
该方法把一个离散自编码器与一个自回归 Transformer 结合:前者把观测转成 token,后者自回归地预测这些 token 随时间的演化。于是智能体可以在模型想象出的轨迹中推演,而不必只在真实环境里训练。
在 WorldFoundry 中,IRIS 以参考性的世界模型项目形式从其上游来源被收录;若要训练和运行它,请前往其代码仓库。

whenToUse.en: Reach for IRIS when you're researching sample-efficient, model-based reinforcement learning and want a transformer world model that trains agents inside its own imagined rollouts.
whenToUse.zh: 当你研究样本高效的基于模型的强化学习,并想要一个能在自身想象推演中训练智能体的 Transformer 世界模型时,可以关注 IRIS。

notFor.en: It isn't a video-generation or text-to-video tool, and there's no in-tree WorldFoundry pipeline yet — you work with it through the upstream repository rather than the shared runtime.
notFor.zh: 它不是视频生成或文生视频工具,目前也没有随附的 WorldFoundry 内建 pipeline——你需要通过上游仓库使用它,而非统一运行时。

en: Transformer-based world model for reinforcement learning
Discrete tokens plus an autoregressive dynamics transformer
Known for sample efficiency — agents learn largely from imagined rollouts
Tracked from its upstream open-source repository
zh: 面向强化学习的 Transformer 世界模型
离散 token 加自回归动态 Transformer
以样本高效著称——智能体主要从想象推演中学习
从其上游开源仓库收录
